question: Buddhadev Das Gupta is a famous musician, associated with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**sarod**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarod player Buddhadev Das Gupta **was an **Indian classical musician.**
 
• He **formerly lived in Kolkata, India**.
 
• He was **one of the musicians **listed in **The Raga Guide by Nimbus Records.**
 
• At the **age of 84**, **Pandit Buddhadev Dasgupta **passed away **in Kolkata in 2018**.
 
• On **February 1st, 1933**, he was **born in the Bihar city of Bhagalpur.**
 
• In **2012, he presented the Padma Bhushan award**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Bismillah Khan, Ali Ahmed, and Hussain Bageshwari Qamar **are famous **shehnai players**.
 
• **Pt. Ravi Shankar, Shahid Parvez Khan, Budhaditya Mukherjee, and Anushka Shankar **are famous **sitar players**.
 
• **Amjad Ali Khan, Bangash Ali, Akbar Khan, and Allauddin Khan **are famous **Sarod players**.
 
• **Asad Ali Khan, Zia Mohiuddin Dagar, Ayyagari Syamasundaram **are the famous **Veena players**.
